ABOUT THE JOB

Europe’s first full-stack AI financial services company

 

We merge best-in-class financial technology; banking, payments, invoicing, accounting, payroll and tax with embedded expert advisory services.

 

We are the force-multiplier. Our system continuously learns from our customers, which means every workflow becomes faster, more accurate and more automated over time saving our customers 100+ hours a year of time wasted on admin.

 

Our team is made up of ambitious, unapologetically curious, slightly crazy ex-founders, veteran fintech operators, AI engineers, creatives and corporate finance experts from the Big Four. We’re serious about excellence, but we’re anything but boring: on weekends you might find us at techno parties, wine tastings, football matches or training new models for fun.

 

If you thrive in a high-commitment, high-reward culture and want the autonomy to deliver your best work, this will be the most exciting team you ever join.

 

Neno is backed by AlleyCorp, Firstminute Capital, Motive Partners and angels from Miro, Coinbase, Mollie, Juni, Deel, HuggingFace & PayPal.

 

The role

 

We are looking for an AI Engineer to join our engineering team who will design, build and operate the agentic AI systems that sit at the core of Neno's product. This is a high-ownership, high-impact role: you will architect and ship the multi-agent workflows, context pipelines, LLM integrations and automation infrastructure that transform how European SMEs manage their accounting, tax, payroll and banking, and you will do it inside a team that treats AI as the product, not a feature bolted on top of one.

 

You will work directly with the VP of Engineering and alongside a team of AI engineers, product builders, and Chartered Accountants to translate complex financial workflows into production-grade AI systems. The domain matters here: Neno must be accurate enough to handle VAT returns, precise enough to reconcile bank feeds and explainable enough that our accountants can supervise and trust it. You will build AI-powered systems that meet that bar.

 

You have deep hands-on experience with agentic AI frameworks, LLM orchestration and retrieval-augmented generation. You think carefully about evaluation, observability and failure modes, not just about what works in a notebook. And you are genuinely excited about the specific challenge of applying AI to financial services workflows, where the cost of a wrong answer is real.

 

What this role is not

 

This is not a role for someone who wants to fine-tune models in isolation or research AI in the abstract. You will be building production systems that handle real financial data for real SME clients, systems that must be accurate, reliable and explainable. The bar is high and the feedback loop is short. Building a company like Neno is fun. We celebrate the wins, learn from the losses and never repeat the same mistakes. This is what it takes to win, and we only want to win.
